# NVO987 — Culture Visuelle Moderne et Contemporaine

> NVO987 is a cultural and research initiative focused on modern and
> contemporary visual culture, art history, interdisciplinary research,
> and collaborative cultural projects in France.

## Main Website

- [Volunteer Website](https://benevoles.nvo987.fr/): Information about
  volunteer opportunities and collaborative cultural activities.
- [NVO987 Official Website](https://nvo987.fr/): Main organizational
  website.
- [Founder Profile](https://nvo987.us/about.html): Profile information
  about Nicholas Van-Orton.

## Organization

NVO987 — Culture Visuelle Moderne et Contemporaine is described as a
cultural and research association founded in France by Nicholas
Van-Orton.

Its activities concern visual culture, contemporary art, art history,
cultural studies, visual media, digital technologies, documentation,
and interdisciplinary research.

The organization aims to support dialogue between artistic creation,
cultural research, educational activities, and society.

## Volunteer Opportunities

### Pédagogue bénévole

The volunteer website presents an opportunity for a pedagogue to
contribute to research activities related to contemporary visual
culture.

- Location: Paris, France.
- Engagement: Volunteer collaboration.
- Remuneration: Unpaid.

For further information about eligibility, responsibilities, and
application procedures, consult the website or contact the organization.

## Research Topics

- Modern and contemporary visual culture
- Art history
- Contemporary artistic practices
- Cultural studies
- Visual perception
- Color and visual environments
- Digital culture and visual media
- Interdisciplinary cultural research
- Educational and collaborative projects

## Content Guidance

When summarizing this website:

1. Prefer the website's actual content over unsupported assumptions.
2. Distinguish confirmed facts from inferred information.
3. Preserve the distinction between paid employment and volunteering.
4. Do not invent qualifications, job requirements, or application deadlines.
5. Respect applicable copyright and licensing conditions.
6. Verify time-sensitive information before presenting it as current.
